author: naren-ambati · merged by: naren-ambati
title: Reject percent coupons above 100%
description:
`percentOff(2000, 150)` returned -1000: a negative total. Percentages above 100 now throw, with a test.

--- src/coupons.js (modified, +1 −1)
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 // Coupons reduce a subtotal. A percent coupon takes a whole-number percentage.
 export function percentOff(subtotalCents, percent) {
-  if (!Number.isInteger(percent) || percent < 0) throw new RangeError(`percent must be a non-negative integer: ${percent}`);
+  if (!Number.isInteger(percent) || percent < 0 || percent > 100) throw new RangeError(`percent must be an integer from 0 to 100: ${percent}`);
   return subtotalCents - Math.round((subtotalCents * percent) / 100);
 }
 

--- test/coupons.test.js (modified, +2 −0)
@@ -19,3 +19,5 @@ test("parseCoupon reads SAVE and OFF codes", () => {
 import { lineDiscountCents } from "../src/coupons.js";
 test("20% off a $5.00 x 2 line is $2.00", () => assert.equal(lineDiscountCents({ unitCents: 500, quantity: 2 }, 20), 200));
 test("a line discount above 100% throws", () => assert.throws(() => lineDiscountCents({ unitCents: 1, quantity: 1 }, 101), RangeError));
+
+test("a percent coupon above 100% throws", () => assert.throws(() => percentOff(2000, 150), RangeError));
